question: Analyze the follow-up visit status of patients with abnormal DST results (DQ<70) at the Children's Healthcare Center from July to October. Perform stratified statistics across the following four dimensions: (1) Age group (0–1 years, 1–3 years, 3–6 years, above 6 years); (2) Gender (male, female); (3) Month of initial visit (July, August, September, October); (4) Severity group (DQ<50 as severe, 50≤DQ<60 as moderate, 60≤DQ<70 as mild). For each dimension, output: the Total number of people in that stratum, the number of follow-up visits, and the follow-up rate (rounded to 2 decimal places, presented as a percentage). Output the final results as plain text.
